ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a coward who stood and fought
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} stood when it counted, more than once, and the habit of running has gone with it.

plain.li: When the shooting started my legs wanted to run. I told them no, and they listened.
I used to know every hiding place in the colony. I've forgotten half of them.

warm.li: The others were counting on me. That turned out to matter more than being scared.

cheerful.li: Stood my ground in the raid. Then I went and had a little shake behind the barn. Still counts.

gloomy.li: Running never saved anyone here. Standing did, sometimes.

cold.li: Flight was an inefficient reflex. I've trained it out.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: vengeful after a loss and an oath
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: After the loss and the oath that followed it, spite has taken root in {PAWN_objective}: {PAWN_pronoun} can't stand a rival under the same roof.

plain.li: I remember every one of them. Every face, every name. I'm keeping a list.
Someone said I should let it go. I smiled and didn't answer.

warm.li: I loved them. That's why I can't forgive the ones who took them.

cheerful.li: I've started sharpening things when I'm upset. I have very sharp things now.

gloomy.li: The anger is all that's left of them that I can hold on to.

cold.li: Debts are meant to be settled. I intend to settle mine.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: world weary after too many losses
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Too many years, too many graves: bleak thoughts come easily to {PAWN_objective} now, and {PAWN_pronoun} is harder to get close to.

plain.li: Another season. The same work, the same worries, fewer of us to share them.
The young ones ask what it was like before. I tell them it was the same, only with more people.

warm.li: I still care. I'm just tired of everything I care about being taken away.

blunt.li: I'm tired. Of all of it.

cheerful.li: I used to bounce back. These days I mostly just land.

gloomy.li: I've seen enough of this world for one life.

cold.li: I have stopped expecting the world to be worth the effort.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a rebel after the council let them down
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Broken promises and lost votes have taught {PAWN_objective} not to take orders kindly: {PAWN_pronoun} plays by {PAWN_possessive} own rules now, and drags {PAWN_possessive} feet when pushed.

plain.li: The council says we're all digging the new cellar tomorrow. We'll see.
I listened to the speaker's whole speech today. Then I went and did what I was going to do anyway.

warm.li: I'd do anything for the people here. Just don't call it an order.

blunt.li: They broke their word. I don't owe them mine.

cheerful.li: They put me on hauling. I've decided to haul in my own, very scenic, order.

gloomy.li: Promises from the council are worth the paper. And we're short on paper.

cold.li: Authority here has proven unreliable. I'll defer to it only when it suits me.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a workaholic after seasons without rest
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Two seasons of hardly a break, and fine work to show for it: {PAWN_pronoun} can't put a job down now, even when {PAWN_pronoun} should rest.

plain.li: They called me to supper three times. I finished the joint first. It needed finishing.
Went to bed, lay there, got up and went back to the bench.

warm.li: The work is how I look after everyone. Stopping feels like letting them down.

cheerful.li: Someone hid my tools to make me take a day off. I found them by lunch. Good day.

gloomy.li: If I stop, I'll have to think. So I don't stop.

cold.li: Breaks are an inefficiency I no longer indulge.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: craven no more after standing their ground
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: When the fighting came, {PAWN_pronoun} stayed, and then stayed again; the first to run is somebody else now.

plain.li: The raid came and I didn't run. I didn't even think about it until after.
I picked up a spear and went to the gate with the others. My hands shook. I went anyway.

warm.li: I couldn't leave them out there alone. Not again.

cheerful.li: Faced down a raider today. Both of us looked surprised.

gloomy.li: There's nowhere to run to anyway. Might as well stand.

cold.li: Running made me a liability. I've corrected that.
